balls.text: full on the wide guideline, shuffles way outside off and drives to long-off for two.
yorker on middle, jammed out into midwicket for one.
back of a length on the stumps at 141 kph, flicked to wide midwicket for two.
full on sixth stump at 143 kph, driven to long-on for one.

knee high full toss on fourth stump, tries to heave this over the leg side but miscues it high swirling over vacant extra cover in the ring and it plops safely for two to bring up a 25-ball half-century.

full hugging the wide guideline at 143 kph, Klaasen tries to reverse scoop this over third man, through the short early and it comes off the back of the blade before taking a carom through fine leg to the rope.
slower length ball on middle, Hosein shuffles way outside off stump before heaving a pull over backward square leg that sails into the fourth row.
slower cutter on sixth stump lands back of a length at 116 kph, Hosein is way out in front of a pull shot and the ball bounces a second time before the keeper.
short and wide at 124 kph, slapped off the toe to the cover sweeper for one.
full and wide, miscues a drive off a bottom edge that bounces wide of the keeper for one.
slower length ball wide outside off, goes to pull and a bottom edge goes to ground bouncing to the keeper.

length ball angled way outside off out of reach of a cut beyond the wide guidelines. Called a wide and Delhi reviews this but it looked clear cut past the guidelines on the live shot. And replays uphold the on-field decision. Review lost.
short ball on the stumps, goes to pull and a top edge swirls over the keeper to the third man rope.
129 kph back of a length on fifth stump, tapped behind point for one.
full on the stumps, driven flat to long-on for one.
full on middle and leg, flicks this to wide long-on for one.
yorker on middle at 146 kph, jammed out back to Nortje.
full and wide, smokes a drive along the ground to the wide cover sweeper for one.
Klaasen targets the DJ stand again over wide long-on! Low full toss at shin height at 141 kph on middle stump, Klaasen shovels this high and deep 96 meters into the stands.
back of a length slower ball wide outside off at 120 kph, goes to cut this and is defeated by the lack of pace getting a thick toe edge that barely carries to the keeper at ankle height.
slower ball lands back of a length on fifth stump and is pulled through midwicket for one.
length ball on sixth stump, miscues another flat bat shot aiming for mid-off and it flutters short of extra cover in the ring for one.
short on the stumps, cracks a pull that sails flat over wide midwicket and thuds into the LCD ad boards.

short on sixth stump, muscles a pull that floats short of Warner charging in off the rope at long-on. He thought about diving for this before pulling back at the last moment. If it was a playoff match he would have laid out.
back of a length on the stumps, punched to long-off for one.
short again on middle, this time Klaasen pumps this much flatter over wide midwicket and it lands in the fifth row.
into the second tier! Quicker ball dug in short and Klaasen rocks back to slaughters this over the DJ stand at wide long-on
good length ball sliding down the leg side off the pads for one.
full on the stumps, punched back to Axar for none.
full on middle, goes for a booming drive and skies this high and wide of the cover sweeper for one.
good length ball way outside off again, left alone again for another wide.
good length ball way outside the guideline, left alone and wide.
length ball outside off, punched to long-off for one.
back of a length on fifth stump, pulled through wide midwicket for one.
133 kph ball lands short on the stumps, pulled through backward square leg for one.
full on the stumps, punched down the ground for one.

back of a length ball on off, goes to cross bat this down the ground and miscues it floating over the bowler, Warner charges in from mid-off trying to deny a single and overruns the ball to open the door for a second.
length ball on fifth stump at 130 kph, slices a drives straight to backward point for none.
shuffles down the track to a 143 kph delivery and drives this in the air inside out over wide mid-off, clears the fielder in the ring and bounces away to the rope.
skids this in flat on leg stump, flicked through square leg for one.
back of a length on fourth stump, goes back to pull flat to deep midwicket for one.
good length ball on middle, flicked through square leg for one.
full on the stumps, goes to heave and miscues this into midwicket for one.
good length on middle, flicked through wide midwicket for one.
back of a length on fourth stump, punched through the off side for one.
flighted full on middle, skips forward and plays an elegant lofted drive high and deep into the sightscreen.
back of a length on fifth stump, punched to wide long-off for one.
good length ball on sixth stump, punched to long-off for one.
good length ball on off, flicked through wide midwicket for one.
full on middle, flicked to deep midwicket for one.
full and wide, slices this high over backward point for one.
full on off, driven back to Axar.
back of a length on off, defended back to Axar.
good length ball punched straight to the off side ring.

full on sixth stump to encourage a slog, Abhishek obliges heaving this flat to wide long-on with a miscued shot and Warner judges this exceptionally well charging in 15 yards off the rope on the straight boundary to intercept this at thigh height before some major fist pumping. Huge wicket in the context of this innings. Axar continues to stamp his authority as Delhi's most valuable player this season.
length ball on fifth stump, slapped to long-off for one.
length ball on sixth stump, slapped to long-off for one.
length ball on sixth stump at 122 kph, Klaasen spanks this on the up high and deep over the long-off rope.
half-volley in the slot on off stump at 139 kph, Klaasen smokes a drive over the outstretched left arm of Mukesh and it sizzles to the mid-off rope.
chest high full toss at 133 kph, miscues a pull that flutters tamely into square leg and they scamper two. No ball called by the square leg umpire on field.
117 kph length ball on seventh stump, miscues this slap to extra cover for none.
136 kph bouncer on fourth stump, left alone. Wide called on height.
back of a length ball on middle at 121 kph keeps a touch low and is flicked through midwicket for one.
full and tailing down the leg side at 136 kph, wide called.
122 kph length ball wider on seventh stump, this time he goes through the off side clattering this through extra cover to beat the sweeper.
length ball on fifth stump at 122 kph, winds up and clubs this high over midwicket with a front foot pull, one bounce over the rope.
back of a length on the stumps, defended to the leg side.
back of a length on fifth stump, punched to extra cover for none.

back of a length again on fourth stump, Brook decides to attack this one with an attempted pull to midwicket but doesn't clear the ring fielder standing 10 yards inside the circle at short midwicket, Axar Patel who was out on the boundary earlier in the over. He juggles this head height chance initially pushing too hard at it thinking it was coming at him at a much faster pace than it was in reality. Axar palms it up in the air to himself and keeps his cool to collect it on the second attempt.
back of a length on fourth stump at 131 kph, defended.

back o fa length ball on fourth stump at 127 kph, sits up for Markram to pull but doesn't get the elevation on this and picks out the boundary rider Axar Patel at wide deep midwicket who takes this catch at head height two yards inside the rope.
fullish length on fourth stump skids a touch low under a drive, underhand by the keeper into the stumps to keep Markram honest.
charges a back of a length ball and muscles this to extra cover for none.
charges a full ball on middle and powers a drive flat over the non-striker's head through mid-on to beat the boundary rider who was fielding quite wide on the rope.
short on fifth stump, punched through cover to the sweeper for one.
full on middle, driven back to the bowler.
full on middle and off, punched to long-on for one.
short on fourth stump, pulled to wide long-on and they settle for a long single.
good length on sixth stump, driven to extra cover for none.
full on the stumps, flicked through midwicket for one.
full on sixth stump, sweeps this flat to deep square leg for one.
slants this in full on middle, punched down the ground to long-on for one.
back of a length on off, flicked through midwicket for one.
full on fourth stump, driven to long-off for one.
flighted full on fourth stump, slog sweeps this a mile high and deep landing 15 rows back over midwicket. It brings up a 25-ball half-century.

dropped! Floated full on fourth stump to encourage a drive, Markram obliges and sends this flat toward Nortje at long-off. He shuffles across to his right very casually five yards inside the rope and snatches at this late to shell it at rib height. His feet were not settled and the rest of his balance was thrown off pushing with hard hands. It was a 6/10 chance on difficulty as far as boundary chances go. He didn't have much ground to cover and came in at a comfortable speed and height. Let the South African brotherhood conspiracy theorists loose!
good length ball skids across seventh stump, Markram beaten trying to cut.
full on fifth stump, miscues a drive to wide long-on for one.
full on the legs, flicked through midwicket for one.
good length ball on fourth stump, punched into the covers for one.
goes for yorker and misses badly at 137 kph as Ishant delivers a knee high full toss on off stump that is swatted back over his head to the mid-on rope.
length ball on fourth stump, heaved on the up high over wide mid-on to the rope.
short on the body, bottom edges a pull into the ground to short fine leg for none.
fullish length ball angled across sixth stump, thumps a drive on the up high over extra cover to the rope.
140 kph delivery lands as a good length ball on fourth stump, punched firmly to extra cover for none.
length ball wide outside off at 121 kph, cracks this through the covers and finds the gap to the rope.
slower ball lands back of a length on off, tap and run into the off side short of mid-off for one.
back of a length on off stump, punched wide of cover for one.

length ball on seventh stump at 119 kph, sat up for him to whack but miscues this flamingo slap trying to go over mid-off and instead it comes off the toe toward extra cover. Simple catch floats to Pandey at chest height on the ring.
back of a length tailing down the leg side past a pull, wide called.
122 kph back of a length on fourth stump, pulled into the ground to midwicket for one.
back of a length on seventh stump at 124 kph, fiddles at this away from his body but misses.
back of a length on seventh stump, slapped into the ground well short of mid-off for none.

back of a length on middle and leg at 135 kph, Tripathi shuffles across his stumps to scoop this high and deep over the keeper clearing the fine leg rope for the first six of the match landing at the base of the LCD ad boards.
back of a length on fifth stump, sliced behind point for two.
back of a length ball on off at 132 kph, Tripathi charges and swings over this aiming to clear midwicket.
back of a length on middle and leg, goes back to flick into midwicket for one.
length ball on sixth stump at 132 kph, clattered through cover to the rope.
back of a length on off, tapped in front of point for one.
back of a length on off at 122 kph, just sits up to be thumped with a pull over midwicket to the rope.

good length ball on fourth stump at 129 kph, guides this behind point and they look to scamper a second. The relay over the stumps to the keeper is just a split second late and the dive by Abhishek is good enough to complete the run.
length ball on sixth stump at 138 kph, punched behind square to deep third for one.
bounced out! Banged in short on fourth stump at 130 kph, Mayank tries to shuffle across to get inside the line to hook but is hustled and gloves this through to the keeper.
124 kph slower length ball on sixth stump, miscued attempted cover drive goes back to Ishant.
back of a length on fifth stump at 136 kph, defended back down the pitch.
length ball on sixth stump at 143 kph, flays a cut high over backward point to the rope beating deep third man running across to his left.
back of a length on the stumps, goes back to flick through fine leg for two.
full on fifth stump, defended to cover.
full on the stumps, flicked just wide of mid-on and they sprint a tight single.
good length ball sprayed way down the leg side at 141 kph, wide called.

fullish length ball seams back in sharply from fifth stump and beats a drive on the front foot, big lbw shout upheld. Mayank calls for DRS just before the timer expires but this looked pretty out live. Only question was whether he was struck in line with off stump or just outside off but it was definitely hitting the stumps. He was hit right on the knee roll on the front foot but with not much of a forward stride. Ball-tracking shows the contact on the pads was marginally outside the line of off stump so the decision has been overturned.
full and angled into the pads at 142 kph, flicked gently but timed well to skid along the turf through midwicket to the rope.
full and angled well down the leg side at 141 kph, wide called.
fullish length angled just inside the wide guideline, left alone hoping for a wide call but none is coming.
good length ball on fourth stump at 136 kph, goes to drive and miscues this back down the pitch.
good length ball on fifth stump, left alone at 121 kph.
length ball on seventh stump at 131 kph, flays this again on the up, not in control of this shot sailing over cover point but clears the ring safely before bouncing away to the rope.
back of a length at 130 kph, slapped on the up and barely clears extra cover before going to the rope.
140 kph delivery lands full and seaming toward off stump, defended back down the pitch.
length ball on seventh stump, slices a drive high between the keeper and short third to the rope.
knee high full toss on fourth stump, punched to long-off for one.
back of a length ball on fourth stump, Axar heaves this 125 kph delivery high and deep 20 rows back over midwicket.
yorker on off, flicked away through wide long-on for one.
yorker on middle, flicked to deep backward square leg for one.

another yorker sprayed even further down the leg side to give another free run. Bhuvneshwar is trying to protect against the short boundary on the off side but is getting the straight line very wrong.
yorker sprayed down the leg side at 129 kph, wide called.
length ball on sixth stump, toe-slaps this gently to long-on for one.
low full toss outside off, slices this wide of the cover sweeper and a diving effort along the rope can't keep the ball in play.
yorker at 135 kph on off, jammed out back to Natarajan.
full on middle, flicked away wide of long-on for two.
low full toss at shin height on middle, flicked over midwicket for one.

yorker on leg stump, jammed out wide of the non-striker. Natarajan ran in front of Ripal to make them hesitate before running and it gets past him for one. Had they taken off immediately it would have been an easy two but instead it's a long single.
134 kph delivery lands full on middle, slams this to long-on for one.

dropped! Thigh high full toss at 133 kph, mishits this trying to heave over midwicket. The fielder Markram charges in hard off the rope covering 25 yards and dives forward but it slips off his fingertips. They take two off of it.
slower bouncer over middle at 110 kph, Axar tries to uppercut this but it's way above him and called wide on height.
bouncer on off stump, top edges a pull that swirls over square leg. Umran Malik charges to his right from short fine leg and dives for this but it lands just inches out of his reach for two.
length ball on the stumps, Axar winds up and clobbers this high and deep over square leg landing in the first row.
length ball on the wide guideline, sliced to deep cover for one.
short on off, pulls this through midwicket for one.
length ball on sixth stump, slapped off the toe to long-on for one.
yorker on middle at 138 kph, Ripal does what Sarfaraz chose not to do and just jams this out into midwicket to survive for the next ball.
bullseye! Yorker length on off stump, Sarfaraz tries to heave this over the leg side rather than jamming it out with a straight bat and pays the price.

full on middle at 137 kph, Sarfaraz gets on his knees trying to scoop this over the keeper while turtling his head out of the way and mostly succeeds getting this to go over short third while tumbling off balance to the ground. Hardly graceful but very effective.
low full toss on middle, flicked to long-on for one.
short on off, pulled to square leg for one.
good length ball on the stumps, punched away for one.

good length ball skids very very low on middle and leg stump underneath a pull. Huge lbw shout denied. He was hit very deep in the crease around the line of leg stump. Looked like a 50/50 call. Markram calls for DRS.  Ball-tracking shows umpire's call just shaving the outside of leg stump. It remains not out.
back of a length on fifth stump, punched through wide cover for one.
charges down the track to a ball dragged way outside off stump. Sarfaraz has to work hard just to reach this to avoid being stumped and toe drags this onto the stumps.
good length ball poked behind point for a tight single.
full on fourth stump, goes to slog sweep and misses. Somehow this misses off stump too.
good length ball wide outside off, slapped through cover for one.
short and wide, goes to cut and picks out backward point on the ring for none.
full on middle, flicked through midwicket for one.
full and wide, slices a drive high over cover for what should be a single but the relay is not collected cleanly by the bowler and squirts away for an overthrow.
full outside leg, flicked to deep midwicket for one.
full on the legs, paddle sweeps this and is cut off by short fine leg for one.
charges first ball after the break and slams a drive flat just past the outstretched left arm of the bowler and skids to the long-off rope.
back of a length on fifth stump, slaps this into cover for one.
fullish length on fifth stump, punched through cover for one.
fullish length ball on middle, prods this into the covers for one.
full on off, prodded to long-off for one.

bold from Hosein! After getting destroyed on the previous ball, he flights it up once more with a touch more air on a similarly fullish length. Marsh tries to repeat the six down the ground but the ball grips and turns to produce a skied outside edge swirling over extra cover. Fielder backpedals five yards from the edge of the ring to take this at chest height.
carts this over the sightscreen into the second tier!  Flighted full on middle, Marsh keeps the hands back and slaughters this 94 meters back over the bowler's head.
full on leg stump, goes to flick through midwicket and a leading edge floats wide of backward point for one.
good length ball on fourth stump, goes back to punch through cover and a diving stop by the sweeper saves two runs.
full on off, punched away into the off side to get off the mark.

flighted and drags this back on a good length to beat Pandey charging. He runs straight past this as it turns enough to beat a flick. He's given up way down the track as it passes just outside off stump. Simple stumping for Klaasen. Third umpire is reviewing this to make sure Klaasen didn't reach in front of the stumps before collecting. His hands are way behind the stumps. Two minutes of our lives we'll never get back...
full length ball slapped to extra cover for one, diving stop by Markram keeps this to a single.
short on fourth stump, goes back to slap this to extra cover for none.
back of a length outside off, goes back to flick into midwicket for one.
back of a length on off, goes back to flick into midwicket for one.
good length ball on fourth stump, prodded to extra cover for none.
back of a length on off, slapped away for one.

sensational low return catch! Half-tracker on eighth stump, Salt goes back to smash this through cover and it sticks in the wicket a touch so he's through the shot a touch more than intended and sends it straight back to Markande at shin height reaching low to his right. The bowler reacts exceptionally well and lunges right to snatch on. The umpires want to refer this to the third umpire to check for a clean catch but Salt marches off knowing it was held.
length ball outside off, slapped short of long-off for one.
full on off, punches this wide of the cover sweeper for two.
good length on off, this time punches through the gap to the cover sweeper for one.
back of a length on fifth stump punched to extra cover for none.
back of a length on fourth stump, punched to wide long-off for one.
back of a length on fourth stump, punched to the cover sweeper to bring up a 28-ball fifty for Marsh, his third in the IPL.
good length ball on the stumps, flicked into midwicket for one.
good length ball on the legs, flicked into vacant midwicket for one.
full on middle, goes back to punch to long-on for one.
short and wide, slaps this to the backward point fielder for none.
googly lands back of a length on fourth stump, goes back to cut to the sweeper for one.

back of a length on fourth stump, not much width but just enough for Salt to open his wrists and cut this behind point to the rope to bring up a 29-ball half-century, his first in the IPL. That also brings up the century partnership.

Brook nearly makes the catch of the tournament, still manages to deny a six! Fractionally short on the stumps, Marsh heaves this flat to wide long-on, Brook leaps up and plucks this one-handed with his right-hand at the height of his arc but is about to fall over the rope so flicks this behind him back into play. He tried to get it high enough with the flick so he could come back over the rope back into play and claim it on the rebound but it was just too far out of his reach and winds up as a single. Five runs saved.
back of a length on off, goes back to punch to the bowler.
back of a length on middle, goes back to punch to long-on for one.
too short on middle and leg, Marsh rocks back again and this time heaves this flat and square over midwicket landing 15 rows back.
length ball on off, rocks back and slams this flat over the non-striker to the long-on rope beating the fielder who was quite wide.
short on middle, backs away and slaps straight to extra cover for none.
full on off, punched away for one.
good length ball on middle, goes back to punch to long-on for one.
googly spins in from fourth stump to leg landing short, Marsh goes back to pull to wide midwicket for one.
good length ball on off, backs away to punch to long-off for one.
full on middle, sweeps this to deep backward square leg for one.
back of a length on the legs, goes back to flick through midwicket for one.
starts with a googly landing short on sixth stump, Marsh goes back to slap to long-on for one.
full on fifth stump at 143 kph, a half-volley with no swing just comes nicely onto the bat and is punched easily back where it came through mid-off to the rope.
good length ball on seventh stump, punched to the cover sweeper for one.
digs this in faster and shorter at 148 kph on the legs again, more pace means more juice for Marsh to pull this higher and deeper over fine leg, 20 rows back into the crowd now.
short on the stumps at 141 kph, pulled fine over deep fine leg into the front row.
short on middle at 145 kph, pulled to deep midwicket for one.
length ball on eighth stump, pulls this off the front foot at 138 kph and laces this through wide midwicket to the rope.
good length on middle, goes back to punch to long-off for one.
back of a length on sixth stump, slapped to extra cover for none.
short and wide, slapped to cover, diving stop on the ring keeps this to one.
back of a length on the stumps, punched to long-off for one.
back of a length sliding down the leg side, goes back to flick and it grazes the toe edge past the keeper to the rope.
back of a length on the stumps, goes back and punches this past the non-striker and beats mid-on to go to the rope.
full on fifth stump, charges and drives to long-on for one.
138 kph back of a length on fifth stump, tap and run into the covers for one.

thigh high full toss on the wide guideline, Marsh reaches out and flays this flat over backward point and it screeches into the boundary foam triangle on the full for six at deep third man just a few yards wide of the fielder running across.

length ball on the stumps at 135 kph, goes to pull and miscues this badly fluttering over midwicket. The fielder runs back from inside the ring and flings himself landing on the nailed in ad mats outside the edge of the circle but Mayank Markande can't get a hand to it, just a yard out of his reach.
good length ball on off, punched past the non-striker to mid-off for one.
back of a length angled across fourth stump, misses a punch beaten on the outside edge.
back of a length on the legs, goes back to flick through to long-on for one.
back of a length on off stump, rocks back to punch through extra cover and finds the gap to the rope.
good length ball skids onto the legs as Marsh clears the front leg to heave for midwicket and misses off the pads, a carom goes to point for a leg bye.
back of a length on fifth stump, punched to cover for none.
length ball on middle, Marsh slams a flat pull that screeches into the Sunrisers dugout as support staff scramble ducking for cover.
good length ball on the stumps, punched short of backward point for none.
back of a length on fifth stump, shuffles forward to this 124 kph delivery and shovels it on the up over wide mid-off bouncing away to the rope.
good length on fourth stump, tap and run into the covers for one.
back of a length on the stumps, defended.
good length ball on off, punched away for a tight single.
back of a length on the stumps, goes to pull and flicks this over midwicket for two.
back of a length on fifth stump at 120 kph, goes to pull and skids low under the shot.
back of a length on the stumps, defended.
back of a length on the stumps, goes back to flick through midwicket for one.
back of a length on the legs, flicked through wide midwicket for one.
flighted more and lands back of a length on middle, goes back to flick into midwicket for one.
arm ball swerves in on a good length on off stump, punched away through cover and pierces the gap to the rope.
back of a length on the stumps, prodded away for one.
length ball swinging away on seventh stump, Salt chases this flat-footed and misses a swish.
back of a length on the hips, flicked through midwicket and they scamper two.
full on fourth stump swinging in a fraction at 131 kph, punches this in the air over the bowler to the mid-off rope.
back of a length on fifth stump, Marsh opens the face and guides this to deep third for one.

drag on! 130 kph delivery angled across fourth stump on a good length, Warner goes to pull but it doesn't come onto the bat and keeps a fraction low to produce the bottom edge that caroms onto the stumps.
134 kph back of a length on off stump, defended to extra cover.
